notes.title: Big Update and Steam Summer Sale!
notes.content:
We just launched a major update for Daiichi Dash which adds Steam Achievements -- see if you can find them all!

Along with achievements, we've enabled cloud saves, so your progress is safe no matter where you play. 

During the Steam Summer Sale we've lowered the price to match our launch discount. There's never been a better time to play!

Check it out and let us know what you think!
We can’t wait to hear from you!

Sincerely,

The Team here at KKM
